projects.name: Vojou Container Terminal
projects.description: Vojou Container Terminal is a greenfield port & harbor project in Dubai, valued at AED 2533.0 million, at under construction. Developed by Rorosh Energy. Lead consultant Preelrura Engineering Consultants with Vanailte Planning and Design. Main contractor Bile Engineering and Construction. Expected completion Sep 2028.

projects.name: Raiqaihud Rail Depot
projects.description: Raiqaihud Rail Depot is a greenfield rail depot project in Dubai, valued at AED 97.5 million, at design. Developed by Shovibeesh Energy. Lead consultant Beeti Architecture. No contractor appointed. Expected completion Apr 2030.

projects.name: Thejaas Interchange
projects.description: Thejaas Interchange is a greenfield road project in Dubai, valued at AED 2904.7 million, at concept. Developed by Qodulour Energy. Lead consultant Detheemsar Engineering Consultants. Main contractor Jishjom Construction and Services and Krupraanis Construction; MEP contractor Sithakim Electromechanical Works. Expected completion Oct 2028.

projects.name: Maivlin Container Terminal
projects.description: Maivlin Container Terminal is a greenfield port & harbor project in Dubai, valued at AED 66.6 million, at completed (3 years). Developed by Hutholqath Real Estate. Lead consultant Bofush Architecture. No contractor appointed. Completed Dec 2023.
